title: LATAM Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Transform the future of beauty with Coty!

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrances, cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. More than products, we deliver experiences that connect people to their best selves.

At Coty, we believe that beauty lies in diversity. We foster a culture of kindness, inclusion, and collaboration, where every talent has the space to grow and shine.

We are looking for a LATAM Talent Acquisition Coordinator to play a key role in building high-performing teams and connecting top talent to our transformational journey across Latin America.

Main Responsibilities

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for strategic and complex roles across LATAM, ensuring excellence, agility, and impact.
  • Partner with leaders and hiring managers, providing insights and ensuring a unique candidate experience aligned with Coty’s values.
  • Conduct structured interviews and apply modern methodologies to identify talent with both cultural and technical fit.
  • Design and implement creative and inclusive sourcing strategies to attract diverse, high-quality talent across multiple channels.
  • Collaborate on global and regional Employer Branding and DE&I initiatives.
  • Track recruitment KPIs and share insights to continuously improve processes and outcomes.
  • Ensure effective use of the ATS and compliance with internal policies and local legislation.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop the direct team, fostering growth and high performance.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish (mandatory for regional scope).
  • 7+ years of solid Talent Acquisition experience, with LATAM regional exposure.
  • Strong expertise in competency-based interviewing and recruitment tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, etc.).
  • Proactive, collaborative, and results-oriented profile with excellent communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

Why Join Coty?

Here you will find an innovative, inclusive, and global environment where you will have the autonomy to make a real impact and contribute to shaping the future of beauty.

If you are passionate about talent, diversity, and regional impact, this opportunity is for you.

Apply now and be part of our journey!

title: IT Risk & Audit Professional
description:
Are you our new colleague?

We’re looking for a IT risk & audit professional at Randstad Global

Sao Paolo, Brazil, hybrid, fulltime

BR&AF

The business risk and audit function (BR&AF) provides assurance and recommendations to the Executive Board and the Audit Committee on Randstad Group’s (risk) management, control and governance practices. Therefore the department facilitates in setting governance standards. It provides advice on internal control improvements, it conducts audits, special investigations and assignments worldwide on request of the Executive Board and Audit Committee. BR&AF’s responsibility includes the quarterly reporting based on: the risk and internal control self assessments, audit results, discussions on internal control weaknesses and analysis of the key risks reported throughout the company's management structure. This also substantiates the Group’s in-control statements.

The global function consists of team members operating through hubs spread over 4 continents. The team is organized in a matrix consisting of control & audit focus teams on business and functional areas (e.g. digital, talent, client, back office & shared service centers and fraud & forensics) and partners that are the linking pin to operating units (business risk & audit partners) with a global view. A support group is set up for professional practice, learning & development, quality improvement & methods, analytics and PMO.

Representatives of the different groups (Focus teams, BR&A Partners and support group) form the BR&AF core management team that reports to the Managing Director BR&AF.

how you will contribute

As IT auditor you are part of the, Business Risk & Audit - IT focus team and are going to:

  • perform and assist internal audit projects and internal control evaluation related to 'digital' processes, such as general IT processes, IT program & project management, 3rd party assurance, security, business IT (automated) controls, RPA, AI and BCP.
  • together with other team members you coordinate, execute and report on the outcomes of risk management, internal control and internal audit in close collaboration with other involved and impacted functions within the group, such as IT and global IT program organizations
  • provide coaching & development for your team members with respect to IT general controls, application controls and other technical expertise's required within Risk & Audit.
  • support the planning, execution and reporting of the risk, internal control and internal audit activities in your domain to make impact. You know your impact is there when management follows-up on your reports by implementing operational and control improvements.

what you will be doing

  • participate in risk assessments and assist in audit planning and scoping, such as: IT general controls, automated controls, RPA and IT projects.
  • perform IT controls/process audits on scope elements.
  • lead and execute audits, for technical domains, including: physical security, ethical hacking and technical validation of controls on multiple OSI layers.
  • support combined comfort analyses on maturity of IT general controls relevant domains (combining audit insights with other sources of data such as internal control projects, management controls self-assessment and developments within the company)
  • participate and lead audit interviews, accountable to prepare audit workpapers and reporting, as well as assist in drafting audit findings and recommendations for management based on identified control weaknesses or process improvements.
  • support and monitor the follow-up implementation of corrective actions by management.
  • act as a resource for colleagues with less expertise.

who will you work with

  • Partners/communities within the IT operations and projects space
  • IT security, data protection, information security and business continuity communities within the Randstad organization.
  • Business risk & audit partners
  • IT & digital leadership
  • External co-source partners
  • BR &A F stakeholders/clients within the business including local MT's, process and control owners

what you will bring

Your in depth understanding and experience with general IT management processes, business enabling through it (automated controls, RPA and IA) combined with risk & audit skills are well developed. As a critical challenger to management you strike the right tone. You have a keen interest in enabling an effective balance in managing IT effectively while enabling the business to operate optimally leveraging IT. You have a sharp eye for improvements strengthening management controls structurally in the context of what works best within the company setting and not taking it from a theoretical perspective.

You:

  • have minimum 5 to 8 years of relevant experience
  • have at minimum a bachelor degree in IT, business or economics.
  • are qualified as IT auditor (e.g. CISA, RE or equivalent).

You work and act in a way that:

  • creates clarity - showing line of sight (analytical skills): you collect and analyze data to solve problems, make decisions and advice within your professional boundaries.
  • collaborates, reaches out (organizational sensitivity): maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process and people-related organizational dynamics recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization
  • ensures the business, thus: align, improve, execute and promote systems and work processes that support the business in achieving its goals and complies with internal and external standards and regulatory requirements.
  • co-drives the business, thus: provide insights into drivers for value creation and act as business partner in making decisions that enhance performance.

have an agile and flexible working style and passion for on the job coaching and development

Your Business English is at level BEC B1/B2 or higher.

your competencies

title: Educational Project Service Leader
description:
We are looking for an Educational Project Service Leader with experience and passion for team management. Your mission will be to ensure that our strategic clients—private, public, and government educational projects, both nationally and internationally—achieve their goals, providing them with the support and guidance necessary for each initiative to succeed.

In this role, you will lead a team dedicated to providing exceptional service, anticipating needs, effectively resolving requirements, and promoting the renewal and growth of these strategic alliances. In addition, you must be available to travel nationally and internationally for short periods of time in order to strengthen relationships and support the execution of key projects.

Main responsibilities

  • Team leadership and development: Lead, guide, and develop the customer service specialist team, ensuring they have the tools, training, and motivation necessary to provide exceptional support. Conduct regular feedback sessions and performance evaluations.
  • Partner support and relationship management: Serve as the main point of contact for those responsible for private, public, and government educational projects, ensuring responsive, effective service with high quality standards.
  • Project operational coordination: Act as an operational liaison with internal areas to ensure the fulfillment of commitments, the timely resolution of requirements, and the proper execution of each project.
  • Growth and renewal of partnerships: Identify and execute opportunities to renew, expand, or scale existing agreements, generating additional value for the parties involved.
  • Process optimization: Establish, improve, and document team workflows, implementing best practices for partner support and key performance indicator (KPI) management.
  • Collaboration with other areas: Work hand in hand with the product, operations, sales, and legal teams to align support actions with the company's strategic objectives, representing the partner's voice in continuous improvement processes.
  • Performance monitoring and reporting: Define and monitor key performance indicators for the team, preparing periodic reports and adjusting strategies when necessary.
  • Team onboarding and training: Oversee the induction and ongoing training of team members, ensuring they are up to date on processes, partner expectations, and policy changes.
  • Field support: Travel when required to support the launch of strategic projects or critical situations, representing the company in face-to-face meetings or interventions.

Skills and requirements:

  • Proven experience leading customer service or project support teams, ideally in educational, government, or corporate partnership environments.
  • Experience managing relationships with external partners or institutional clients, with a focus on building long-term relationships.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly.
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach.
  • Organizational skills and ability to handle multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in technological tools, CRMs, and support platforms.
  • Adaptability and resilience to work in dynamic environments with different types of stakeholders.
  • Availability to travel nationally and internationally for short periods.
  • English level B2 or higher.

Desirable requirements:

  • Experience working with public institutions, ministries of education, NGOs, or corporate education programs.
  • Knowledge of EdTech platforms, SaaS tools, or educational services.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar.
  • Experience coordinating projects with multiple stakeholders and measurable results.

title: Consultor (a) | Foco em Mineração de Dados e Projetos
description:

description:

title: Sales Performance Manager
description:
At Discover the World, we’re passionate about sales, people, and travel. We represent over 120 top-tier brands across the globe, delivering local expertise through innovative strategies. Our work positively impacts clients, trade partners, and travelers every day. We foster a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can thrive—and we’re looking for someone who shares that vision.

As the Sales Performance and Engagement Manager for Latin America (Argentina, Mexico, Brazil), you will be responsible for supporting several Sales Teams across these markets to maximize success and capability, while guiding individuals to achieve their full potential and business targets.

You will play a critical role in driving revenue growth through ongoing training, structured sales processes, and performance management. You will be pivotal in developing a framework that improves productivity and commercial knowledge across all members of the team. Your ability to coach, mentor, and motivate sales teams will be instrumental in achieving success in a highly diverse region.

Role Responsibilities

  • Support the strategic leadership of the LATAM sales team in achieving their goals and objectives through ongoing training, coaching, and performance management.
  • Support the development of localized sales strategies to grow market share and increase revenue generation, while responding to client needs across Argentina, Mexico, and Brazil.
  • Mentor a diverse sales team, consisting of key account managers, sales executives, and business development teams.
  • Train and coach sales and global teams in data analytics to understand market trends, competitive landscape, and identify opportunities through informed business decisions.
  • Report to and support the Global Head by conducting regular performance evaluations and providing constructive feedback to enhance individual and team performance.
  • Collaborate with the Training Manager to develop and deliver sales training programs tailored to the LATAM region.

Role Requirements

  • Proven track record of success in sales leadership roles, including coaching and training teams, with strong sales standards.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills across different languages and audience sizes.
  • Ability to work in a matrix management structure with multiple stakeholders and priorities.
  • Strong business acumen, with experience implementing sales processes and increasing productivity.
  • Demonstrated leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team across multiple countries.
  • Analytical mindset with ability to leverage data to drive decisions.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and relevant sales tools.
  • Graduate degree in Business or related field preferred.

Languages required: Fluent in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

Knowledge of travel industry (B2B online travel, hospitality, or travel-related technology) preferred; candidates from FMCG, retail, and events also considered.

Personal Qualities

  • Strong personal drive to achieve results through teamwork.
  • Self-starter who can work independently without close supervision.
  • Positive, problem-solving, and adaptable mindset.
  • Conflict resolution skills with a calm and empathetic approach.
  • Forward-thinking and modern outlook.
  • Strong personal ethics and integrity.
  • Approachable and engaging leadership style.

Why Join Us?

At Discover the World, we’re passionate about sales, people, and travel. We bring world-class brands into global travel communities through innovative local strategies. Our work positively impacts our clients, partners, and travelers every day. We foster a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can thrive—and we’re looking for someone who shares that vision.

title: MBRAS Partner - Consultor Imobiliário de Alto Padrão
description:
Consultor Imobiliário de Alto Padrão (Programa PARTNERS MBRAS)

Localização: São Paulo, Capital

Sobre a MBRAS

A MBRAS é líder no mercado imobiliário de altíssimo padrão em São Paulo desde 2010. Reconhecida por sua inovação e excelência, a empresa oferece experiências imobiliárias exclusivas, consultoria especializada e gestão de ativos para uma clientela selecionada.

Buscamos empreendedores, diretores, engenheiros, advogados, vendedores do mercado de luxo, dentre outras profissões que desejam atuar como nossos Consultores Associados neste segmento promissor, aproveitando toda estrutura e prestígio da marca MBRAS.

• Prestar consultoria especializada aos clientes, entendendo suas necessidades e oferecendo soluções personalizadas.

• Perfil empreendedor com desejo de crescimento no mercado imobiliário de luxo.

• Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.

• Alto nível de ética e profissionalismo.

• Interesse em educação contínua e desenvolvimento profissional.

title: Especialista de Qualidade
description:
Principais responsabilidades

  • Orientar tecnicamente a área de projetos nos temas referentes a qualidade de equipamento e interface entre a tecnologia SIG e a solução de upstream utilizada pelo cliente.
  • Definir junto do time global os insumos que influenciam na assepsia do equipamento de envase.
  • Realizar treinamentos de qualidade para os clientes, aumentando o nível de instrução dos colaboradores do cliente, diminuindo falhas e estreitando a parceria SIG/Cliente.
  • Avaliar as novas formulações e compatibilidade com o equipamento de envase baseado nas documentações e expertise SIG.
  • Sugerir alterações nos processos de comissionamento, operação e manutenção do equipamento quando for conveniente para manter o correto funcionamento de nossa tecnologia.
  • Realizar validações de linhas de envase de acordo com critérios FDA.
  • Orientar os clientes em monitoramentos e metodologias que garantam o Shelf Life do Produto Final para evitar a deterioração do produto.
  • Avaliar as solicitações de alterações e adequações dos processos pela SIG global, de forma a manter contato com os pares globais da posição.
  • Ter conhecimento sólido na documentação SIG para poder disseminar os procedimentos e instruções técnicas, desafiar e/ou modificar (baseando-se em conceitos assépticos), além de ser referência para essas consultas pelo time técnico em especial, FSEs.
  • Ser mentor no desenvolvimento das competências técnicas dos consultores de qualidade e time de serviços técnicos.
  • Atuar com o time global da empresa em grupos de trabalho focado em melhorias preventivas no sistema de envase SIG na busca da redução dos índices de reclamações de mercado (MCR).
  • Atuar proativamente desde o desenvolvimento das embalagens, fabricação, envase e clientes para promover a criação da Cultura de Qualidade end to end .

Suas habilidades, experiência e formação

  • Superior completo em Engenharia de Alimentos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em Gestão de Qualidade e Segurança de Alimentos;
  • Vivência em indústria de alimentos, preferencialmente em indústria de lácteos ou sucos;
  • Inglês avançado (interface com time global);
  • Espanhol intermediário (interface com time AM-S);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (100% do tempo em clientes AM-S).

O que nós oferecemos

  • Salário competitivo com o mercado
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Previdência Privada
  • PPR
  • Vale refeição
  • Vale alimentação
  • WellHub
  • Subsídio a estudo (de acordo com política específica)
  • Auxílio creche e outros.

Competências da SIG

Estamos procurando por pessoas que estejam buscando alcançar resultados de forma consistente, mesmo sob circunstâncias difíceis. Colaboradores que consigam criar um ambiente em que todos sejam motivados a dar o seu melhor a fim de que a organização alcance seus objetivos. Se você está sempre buscando novas maneiras de crescer e enfrentar desafios, se trabalha no desenvolvimento de pessoas capazes de conquistar suas metas profissionais além das metas da organização, a SIG tem um lugar para você. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós.

Nosso Compromisso

A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira; um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, e terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, além de capacitação e orientação profissional junto de colegas de equipe experientes. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio.

Sobre a SIG

A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor.

Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange.

title: Commercial Coordinator
description:
1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

The Data Integration Specialist designs and implements the technical infrastructure needed to consolidate the school’s data into a centralized repository. This role develops and maintains automated data pipelines, integrates multiple systems, and ensures data is structured for reporting. The specialist also supports the creation of dashboards and visualizations in Looker Studio, Power BI, or custom web applications, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate data from multiple school systems and spreadsheets.Automated data pipelines (APIs, CSV, ETL processes, cloud-based tools) reducing manual work and improving accuracy.
  • Build and manage automated ETL processes (APIs, SQL, Python scripts, CSV workflows).
  • Use Microsoft cloud tools (e.g., Data Factory, Power Automate) to streamline and automate workflows.Dashboards and reports delivered in Looker Studio, Power BI, or custom-built web applications.
  • Maintain and enhance data-oriented web applications based on front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React) and backend development (e.g., Python or .NET).
  • Document data structures, pipelines, and integration standards to ensure long-term sustainability.
  • Collaborate with the Systems & Data Admin to validate that technical outputs meet business needs.
  • Ensure solutions are cost-effective and appropriate for a K12 international school context.

Qualifications

Candidates should bring most or all of the following:

  • Solid experience in a similar role.
  • Experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, or similar).
  • Ability to design data models and schemas for reporting.Strong technical skills in data integration (APIs, SQL, CSV, ETL).
  • Proficiency with visualization tools (Looker Studio, Power BI).Proficiency with Python for data manipulation and system integration.
  • Familiarity with cloud automation tools (Microsoft Data Factory, Power Automate).
  • Ability to support and maintain custom dashboards and webapps (Azure, Python, Angular, Bootstrap).Use of Git/version control and documentation for maintainability.
  • Apply data quality assurance practices: cleaning, validating, monitoring pipelines.
  • Shows humility and confidence.
  • Tech "positive" - see upsides and opportunities in using tech for learning

title: Managing Director
description:
About Us

XCELiS is made up of a team of Supply Chain specialists with over 15 years of experience optimizing and transforming business results in Brazil and abroad.

We operate end-to-end across the supply chain, from design to implementation, delivering performance optimization and results-driven projects in areas such as Logistics Network, Transportation, Warehousing, Planning, E-Commerce/Omnichannel, Procurement, Technology, and Control Tower.

We are certified in Organizational Climate by FEEx 2023 and 2024, recognized as leaders in Supply Chain Advisory and Consulting Services and as Contender in the Supply Chain IT Operation Services quadrant of the ISG Provider LensTM Supply Chain Services Brazil 2023 study. In addition, we were awarded 1st place by INBRASC in 2023 in the categories Logistics Consulting and TMS Provider.

Job descripiton:

The Managing Director in Supply Chain Transformation at XCELiS is a senior, entrepreneurial, and visionary leader responsible for expanding new business and leading end-to-end supply chain transformation projects. This professional will combine deep expertise in logistics, planning (S&OP), procurement, and digital technologies. The goal is to position XCELiS as the leading consulting firm in supply chain solutions, delivering measurable value, pragmatism, resilience, competitive advantage, and results for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development and Market Strategy

  • Manage the financial performance (P&L) of projects in partnership with the finance team.
  • Lead the prospecting of complex Supply Chain projects, from diagnosis to the implementation of S&OP, logistics, and digitalization solutions.
  • Act as the primary advisor to C-level clients (CSCO, COO, CEO), translating their business challenges into robust supply chain strategies.
  • Develop and price value propositions that clearly demonstrate ROI, focusing on cost optimization, service improvement, and risk mitigation.
  • Represent XCELiS in the Supply Chain ecosystem by speaking at events, publishing articles, and building a strong professional network.

Leadership and Delivery of Supply Chain Projects

  • Oversee the delivery of a portfolio of projects, ensuring the application of best practices in demand planning, inventory management, logistics network optimization, and automation.
  • Provide final review and strategic guidance to project teams, ensuring solutions are not only theoretical but also practical and high-impact.
  • Manage the inherent challenges of transformation projects, such as change management, system integration (ERP, WMS, TMS), and stakeholder alignment.
  • Lead and mentor a team of specialized Supply Chain consultants, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • Identify emerging trends (AI in logistics, blockchain, sustainability in supply chains) and develop new service offerings for XCELiS.

Qualifications and Competencies

Academic Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, etc.), Business Administration, or Economics.
  • Postgraduate degree, MBA, Master’s, or PhD with a focus on Supply Chain or Logistics is highly desirable.

Technical Skills (Supply Chain)

  • End-to-end supply chain expertise: Planning (S&OP/IBP), Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics (Transportation and Warehousing), and Customer Service.
  • Proven experience leading logistics network optimization projects, distribution center design, TMS/WMS implementation, and inventory management strategies.

title: Information Technology Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: On-Site IT Support Engineer

Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.

Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.

Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.

Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.

Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.

Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.

Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.

Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.

Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.

Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.

Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.

Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.

Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.

Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.

Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose

The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.

⸻

Core Responsibilities

• Financial Control & Compliance

• Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

• Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.

• Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Reporting & Deliverables

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts.

• Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

• Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.

• Prepare and monitor hedge calculations, manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.

• Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.

• Collaboration & Insights

• Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.

• Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules.

• Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.

• Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.

• Business Development & Bids

• Support the analysis of new bids and tenders, with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.

• Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.

⸻

Key Qualifications

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.

• Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.

• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

• Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.

• Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.

• Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.

• Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.

• Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

title: Analista de Planejamento Comercial e CRM pleno
description:
Sobre a Bip

Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...

I. Ser a empresa que sempre sonhamos e que sonhamos para sempre

Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

II. Presente em ecossistema inovador

Significa ter e desenvolver constantemente, internamente ou através de parceiros, soluções inovadoras que promovam impactos em nossos clientes e que sejam o pilar de nossa perenidade. Pois só um repensar constante nos manterá atuantes no mercado.

III. Socialmente Engajada

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

Nossos benefícios são flexíveis e você poderá distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades e interesses:

  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens)
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Meu Pet Club
  • Mobilidade (incluindo opção de combustível)
  • Reembolso Flex (óculos, vacinas, educação e outros)
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação

Bem-estar: VT, Birthday off, Gympass, Licença Maternidade de 180 dias e Licença Paternidade de 30 dias, além de auxílio creche no primeiro ano do bebê.

Sobre a vaga:

Principais Atividades:

  • Suporte à área comercial referente a processos de encarteiramento de clientes no CRM.
  • Monitoramento dos indicadores de processamento do CRM e elaboração de relatórios desses indicadores.
  • Análise e estudo dos modelos de alocação comercial para otimização de recursos.
  • Contribuição para a melhoria contínua dos processos de suporte, elaboração de relatórios.
  • Garantir reports diários e semanais de acompanhamento do volume de vendas.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração de Empresas / Engenharia / Economia e áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em área de planejamento comercial.
  • Desejável experiencia com o uso do Salesforce.
  • Competência na análise e interpretação de dados financeiros e comerciais.
  • Conhecimento de SQL, Power BI e ou Python (pandas).
  • Forte habilidade de relacionamento, negociação e análise.
  • Boa capacidade de organização, gestão de tempo e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Excel, PBI, SQL e/ou Knime e o Phyton será um diferencial.

Vaga também para PcD

SOMOS DIFERENTES DE TUDO O QUE VOCÊ JÁ VIU!

Faça parte da BIP: Um ecossistema inovador, humano, ousado e revolucionário.

Somos uma consultoria internacional de transformação de negócios, fundada na Itália em 2003, há 20 anos impactando milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho.

Com nosso espírito jovem, vivemos em um ecossistema em evolução que entrega transformação significativa por meio de uma abordagem personalizada.

Por aqui, não falta oportunidade para você crescer.

ESTAMOS PRESENTE EM DIVERSOS LOCAIS DO MUNDO!

+40 países de atuação + 5000 Bipers pelo mundo +700 projetos no mercado

Tudo o que temos e construímos para um futuro que se aproxima, é guiado pelo nosso

PROPÓSITO:

Pursuing Changes, Nurturing Progress

A mudança é a base de nossa mentalidade, aprendemos e reaprendemos constantemente. Somos desafiadores, assumimos o risco de explorar novas formas de tornar as coisas melhores, inovadoras e sustentáveis para nós, para os nossos clientes e para a sociedade a qual pertencemos. Esforçamo-nos para criar o que ainda não existe, bem como para cuidar e fazer crescer o que existe. Não deixamos pedra sobre pedra – isso é o quão longe ousamos ir.

title: Analista Pleno de Modelagem Estatística
description:
A inovação e o pioneirismo sempre fizeram parte da nossa história, que começou em 1980. Temos o DNA de varejo, já que nascemos da Pernambucanas – marca centenária que sempre contou com os serviços financeiros para apoiar as famílias brasileiras de maneira fácil e democrática. Ao longo dos anos, as soluções evoluíram e se diversificaram, permitindo à Pefisa se consolidar no mercado financeiro.

Somos responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e gestão de produtos como cartões, empréstimo pessoal, seguros e a conta digital, com diferenciais como simplicidade, praticidade e sem burocracia. Prezamos por bons relacionamentos, pelo atendimento próximo e por jogar junto.

Com mais de 5 milhões de clientes ativos e grande relevância na área do varejo, disponibilizamos um amplo portfólio de serviços para pessoas físicas e jurídicas, além de um Banking as a Service (BaaS) para marcas de diversos segmentos. Com isso, adotamos iniciativas inovadoras para clientes e parceiros.

Na Pefisa tudo é simples. Tudo é rápido. Te ajudamos com o que você precisa para realizar seus sonhos ou alavancar seu negócio. E você escolhe como quer conversar, pois nós somos Fígital. Atuamos com a melhor experiência entre o físico e o digital, com nossas plataformas digitais ou através de nossas lojas físicas. Somos a fintech pra gente como a gente.

Se você se identifica com nossos valores, essa é a sua chance de brilhar!

Analista Pleno de Modelagem Estatística

Resumo da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Analista Pleno de Modelagem Estatística para integrar nosso time. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver, validar e implementar modelos estatísticos para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais da empresa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e aplicar modelos estatísticos para análise de dados e previsão de tendências.
  • Realizar tratamento, limpeza e análise exploratória de dados.
  • Validar e monitorar a performance dos modelos, garantindo sua aderência e robustez.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender necessidades de negócio e traduzir em soluções estatísticas.
  • Documentar processos, resultados e apresentar insights.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de programação e softwares estatísticos para análise e modelagem.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos modelos e metodologias aplicadas.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Economia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em modelagem estatística e análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento avançado em técnicas de regressão, séries temporais, análise multivariada, machine learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como R, Python, SAS ou similares.
  • Habilidade em manipulação e tratamento de grandes volumes de dados Conhecimento em visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) será um diferencial.
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e boa comunicação para apresentação de resultados.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com modelos preditivos aplicados a negócios financeiros, seguros ou varejo.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

Certificações relacionadas a estatística, ciência de dados ou análise preditiva

  • Orientação a objetos : encapsulamento, herança, polimorfismo, abstrações, interfaces, agregação e composição;

  • Ferramentas de IA : conhecimento na utilização de IA para apoio ao desenvolvimento de software;
  • Metodologias ágeis : experiência com Scrum, Kanban ou similares.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Vivência prévia com produtos financeiros, especialmente crédito.

title: Volunteer Doctor, South Africa
description:
Are you passionate about using your knowledge and skills to help others? Answer your calling, and take your leave of purpose.

The Tshemba Foundation is appealing to international doctors to address a critical health care gap in rural South Africa’s north eastern provinces where doctor shortages are posing substantial challenges to adequate health care.

You will experience and learn from a stimulating and challenging working environment, treat conditions and cases not usually seen in urban areas and help leave a legacy of improved quality of care by sharing knowledge and skills with local staff who are eager for support.

Tshemba offers its volunteers free, safe and secure accommodation at its Volunteer Lodge, situated in Moditlo Private Game Reserve. The Lodge serves as a welcome off-duty refuge where like-minded healthcare providers relax after an intense day of work. Here they exchange ideas, create healthcare solutions for daily challenges faced and connect with peers from all over the world, all the while taking in the magnificent natural surroundings.

In your role as a volunteer doctor you can offer:

  • direct or indirect patient care in various departments of a public hospital and/or surrounding clinics
  • postgraduate support to medical staff in training
  • skills development and/or formal teaching for local staff
  • administrative or management support, including clinical and quality improvement projects
  • develop health interventions and protocols alongside local staff

Our clinical team will work with you to develop a personalized volunteer schedule that combines your skills and experience with the needs of various hospital departments and clinics in the area.

Length of placement:

  • Currently, volunteer placement lengths are flexible based on your area of expertise. We recommend a minimum of 8 weeks for generalist international volunteers and can negotiate shorter stays for specialists. We will work with you to determine where you will be placed and how long your stay will be to have maximum impact.

Requirements:

  • A current license in good standing from your medical regulatory body
  • Registration with ECFMG and the Health Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) which our team will assist you to apply for. Current ECFMG certification will expedite the process.
  • We welcome interest from ALL REGISTERED PHYSICIANS however, the greatest current need are for Radiologists, Family physicians, Geriatricians, Neurologists, Dermatologists, Internists, Psychiatrists, Paediatricians, Gastroenterologists, Ophthalmologists and General Surgeons.

Physicians who have volunteered with Tshemba tell us that they have been re-energized and transformed by the experience, and their passion for medicine reignited.

Please reach out if you have any questions and to discuss volunteering your time.

MEIDE Group is a global leader in the manufacturing of ductile iron pipes, valves, malleable iron fittings, and pipeline system solutions, with a footprint in over 100 countries. As part of our strategic growth in Serbia, we are looking for a capable and experienced Sales Representative to join us and support market development in the region.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and manage local distributors, wholesalers, and key accounts in the relevant hardware industry;
  • Promote MEIDE’s products and brands;
  • Identify and pursue business opportunities in potential projects;
  • Lead the full sales cycle: customer identification, presentations, quotations, contract negotiation, and after-sales follow-up;
  • Build long-term relationships with contractors, project consultants and resellers;
  • Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to optimize strategy and product offerings;
  • Coordinate with internal departments including technical, logistics, and finance to ensure smooth order fulfillment and customer satisfaction.

Requirements:

  • 2~3 years of sales experience in a related industry (e.g., pipes, valves, pumps);
  • Proven ability to independently develop distribution channels and major accounts;
  • Good understanding of the local construction materials and infrastructure market;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Mandarin Chinese is a plus;
  • Excellent skills in business development, communication, and relationship management;
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, International Business, or related fields;
  • Willingness to travel as needed within Brazil.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary;
  • Clear career development path and opportunities for international collaboration;
  • Strong technical and brand support from a global leader;
  • Friendly, pragmatic, and growth-driven corporate culture.

Join Us:

If you have solid experience in sales and are ready to grow with a global enterprise in a dynamic market, we welcome your application to join MEIDE Group!

Application Process:

To apply, please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience. Qualified candidates will be contacted within two weeks for an initial interview, with additional interviews as necessary.

title: Commercial Contract Specialist II
description:
Nidec Aerospace is seeking a Sales & Contract Manager who will be directly responsible for managing the customer relationship, negotiating supply agreements, and ensuring that all contractual commitments are properly structured, tracked and executed successfully. This is a hands-on role working closely with the Chief Commercial Officer that combines sales, commercial negotiation, contract execution, and ERP purchase order management.

The individual is responsible for

Sales & Contract Negotiation:

· Build strong, trusted relationships with customers

· Prepare and deliver sales presentations, offers, and quotations

· Review and negotiate contract terms (scope, pricing, delivery schedules, payment terms, warranties, penalties, etc.)

· Ensure signed contracts are properly documented, communicated, and stored

Contract Execution:

· Serve as the customer’s primary point of contact for commercial and contractual matters.

· Act as the contract owner post-signature, ensuring all commitments are fulfilled. Manage contract extensions, and amendments

· Work hand-in-hand with the program team to monitor, track and negotiate commercial impact due to technical change per contractual terms

· Support program managers in resolving commercial issues with customers

· Identify risks and work with program team to deploy contingency plan

ERP & Order Management

· Enter and maintain all contracts and orders in the ERP system

· Manage delivery milestones, invoicing, and payments in ERP in collaboration with Logistic and Accounting team

· Monitor receivables and work with Finance to secure timely payments

· Work closely with Trade and Compliance teams to ensure compliance with company policies, export controls, and regulatory requirements

· Update CRM with contract detail and customer interaction, ensuring it reflects real-time status

Technical Attributes and Experience

· Strong negotiation and contract management skills

· Hands-on, detail-oriented, and execution-driven

· Excellent ERP proficiency for order/contract tracking and reporting

· Experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce.com

· Presentation skills

· Ability to bridge commercial and operational priorities

· Strong communication skills with customers and cross-functional teams

· Financial awareness (payment terms, penalties, DSO, margin protection)

Minimum Requirements (proficiency levels aligned to job level)

· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field

· 5–8 years of experience in contract management, commercial management, or program execution (industrial, engineering, aerospace, or similar sector preferred)

· Hands-on experience managing contract execution in close coordination with program/project teams

· Proven experience using ERP and CRM systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce or equivalent)

· Proficiency in Business English

title: JAMS Automation Engineer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.

We are looking for a highly talented and self-motivated to join us on our journey to advance the world of technology through innovation and creativity.

This role will be responsible for automating repeatable processes in Sompo’s public cloud and on-premise datacenter environments to improve process efficiencies. This role will be responsible for developing, documenting, maintaining, supporting, and optimizing automation workflows. Subject matter expertise is required in Microsoft PowerShell scripting.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, test and validate PowerShell scripts as part of automation workflows and maintain in source control for change management.

• Create and Maintain a Dynamic Inventory of all JAMS Scheduler Jobs.

• Create and maintain a JAMS incident tracker for logging dates and times of all warnings and errors from JAMS Scheduler Jobs as well as escalation and fix details.

• Update Job properties (Schedules, Source Code etc.) as directed by Job owners.

• Proactively review and monitor the health of all JAMS Jobs i.e. daily reviewing output of all jobs.

• Review job failures and take corrective action where possible or escalate to Job owner as necessary.

• Log Service Desk ticket (incident) for all JAMS Scheduler Job failures, provide resolution in collaboration with job owner and maintain incident resolution log\ knowledge base.

• Installation of JAMS Client tools, JAMS software updates and\or reporting tools.

• Liaise with JAMS account representative and Sompo procurement in relation to JAMS Scheduler annual support License renewals.

• Participate in IT projects, responsible for development of automation workflows outlined in the Project Plan and directed by the Project Manager, at whatever level of effort or participation has been defined for them.

• Build, administer, monitor and maintain JAMS Enterprise Scheduler and System Center Orchestrator environments.

• Work with Application team members to evaluate automation workflow needs and requirements.

• Develop integrations between infrastructure systems for data analysis and reporting through REST API calls.

• Maintain JAMS platform, standard operating procedures, perform changes, apply patches, and updates as required.

• Prevent, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve automation runbook errors.

• Maintain strict change control of the automation infrastructure.

• Continuously identify and report areas of improvement in the automation arena and implement improvements when approved.

• Contribute to on-going research and evaluation of new technologies.

• Responsible for completing other work requirements or tasks that are requested by IT management when necessary to meet the goals and objectives of the department or company.

• Working continuously on a task until completion to ensure business automation workflows remain available 24/7.

• The ability to multitask while ensuring the highest quality of work is maintained.

• Establishing a good working relationship with customers and other IT groups.

• Be able to work independently within established policies and procedures.

• Perform routine tasks unsupervised.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent technical skills including however not limited to Microsoft Operating systems server including PowerShell scripting, Microsoft SQL Server , Microsoft Azure including Logic Apps, JSON Scripting, REST API.

• Azure or AWS Certification is desirable.

• Experience with System Center Orchestrator 2012 or later preferred.

• Experience with JAMS Enterprise Manager is highly desirable and preferred.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong background in an Infrastructure environment with a minimum of 5 years’ experience.

• Team orientated with the ability to multitask and prioritize workloads.

• Very strong problem solving and analytical skills and is a systemic thinker with an attention to detail.

• Seeks to expand knowledge and experience and is committed to continuous learning.

Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect

Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Principal Architect
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Additional Information

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Tax Sr Analyst (Advanced English)
description:
Join Our Team as Tax Sr Analyst – Brazil (São Paulo) Advanced English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Department: Finance LATAM

Reports to: Senior Tax Manager LATAM

Are you a seasoned tax professional ready to lead and make an impact in a global organization? We’re looking for a Tax Sr Analyst to oversee tax compliance and strategic initiatives for our Brazilian entity. This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your expertise will shape tax operations and support business growth.

What You’ll Do

As Tax Sr Analyst, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading tax compliance for direct and indirect taxes in Brazil.
  • Preparing tax calculations for review by external advisors (EY, Deloitte).
  • Managing deferred tax accounting (IFRS and BRGAAP), including annual and half-year calculations.
  • Overseeing reconciliations for tax GL accounts using SAP and Blackline.
  • Coordinating SPED, municipal obligations (withholding tax), IBGE, and BACEN reporting.
  • Supporting Transfer Pricing processes with external specialists.
  • Advising internal teams on tax treatment for various operations.
  • Staying ahead of regulatory changes, including Brazil’s ongoing Tax Reform.
  • Collaborating with external auditors and tax authorities during audits.
  • Leading a team of 3 direct reports and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 6 years in Brazilian tax (local & international), tax accounting, and compliance.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting or Tax.
  • Technical Skills: SAP, SPED, HFM (BRACS), Blackline.
  • Tax Expertise: IRPJ, CSLL, ISS, PIS, COFINS, ICMS; knowledge of tax treaties and audit processes.
  • Languages: Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, analytical mindset, team leadership, and collaboration.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a global company with a strong presence in LATAM.
  • Lead impactful tax projects and contribute to strategic decisions.
  • Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for development and innovation.

title: Formação em Corretor de Seguros
description:
Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros!

Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;

Após a conquista da Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará, se possuir:

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.

PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:

  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.
