At Globant Gut, we are looking for a senior professional in Marketing Data Analytics to join our team as a Business Intelligence Semi Sr.

title: Gerente de Gestão Manufatura
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m2.

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Gerente de Gestão Manufatura, você irá:

Com foco em vendas como ponto de partida, conformidade como base e cadeia de suprimentos e manufatura como motores principais, busca-se uma coordenação completa da cadeia para realizar o ciclo virtuoso de “pedido – produção – entrega – lucratividade”. As áreas envolvidas incluem: vendas, planejamento, compras, cadeia de suprimentos, produção, qualidade, armazenagem, logística, certificações e conformidade regulatória.

  • Definir e executar a estratégia operacional anual e de longo prazo da fábrica, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos globais do grupo;
  • Otimizar os processos de produção, promovendo manufatura enxuta e melhoria contínua para aumentar a eficiência e reduzir custos operacionais;
  • Supervisionar o planejamento de produção, assegurando a entrega pontual dos pedidos dos clientes e atendendo às demandas do mercado;
  • Garantir que a operação da fábrica esteja em total conformidade com as regulamentações ambientais, trabalhistas, fiscais e setoriais do Brasil;
  • Manter relações com órgãos governamentais (como o Ministério Público Federal e o Ministério da Agricultura), sindicatos e associações setoriais (como a ABIMAQ e a Fenabrave), assegurando um ambiente operacional estável;
  • Liderar a identificação e qualificação de fornecedores locais (como siderúrgicas e fabricantes de componentes), negociar contratos e estabelecer parcerias de longo prazo para reduzir a dependência de importações e os custos logísticos;
  • Equilibrar os estoques de matérias-primas e produtos acabados, considerando os desafios logísticos do Brasil (como congestionamento portuário e problemas no transporte rodoviário), garantindo a disponibilidade de materiais para produção;
  • Construir e desenvolver equipes locais multidisciplinares (produção, qualidade, manutenção, recursos humanos), promovendo programas de capacitação técnica e segurança no trabalho;
  • Promover uma cultura de segurança, qualidade e comprometimento, reduzindo a rotatividade de funcionários e elevando o nível operacional;
  • Implementar sistemas de gestão da qualidade adaptados ao mercado brasileiro (como ISO 9001 e IATF 16949), supervisionando inspeções de entrada (IQC), inspeções de processo (IPQC) e inspeções de saída (OQC), reduzindo retrabalho e reclamações de clientes;
  • Monitorar os custos operacionais (mão de obra, matérias-primas, energia), liderando iniciativas de redução de custos sem comprometer a qualidade e a segurança.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Industrial ou Administração de Empresas;
  • Experiência anterior na indústria de manufatura;
  • Experiência em setores específicos como automotivo ou mecânico será considerada um diferencial;
  • Experiência em gestão de fábricas localizadas no Brasil ou na América Latina, com profundo conhecimento dos processos produtivos (montagem, usinagem, logística interna);
  • Familiaridade com as legislações brasileiras pertinentes, como leis trabalhistas, ambientais, tributárias e normas de segurança do trabalho;
  • Experiência na implementação de práticas de produção enxuta (Lean Manufacturing), sistemas ERP (como SAP) e ferramentas de gestão da produção (como MES);
  • Fluência em inglês ou chinês para comunicação com equipes internacionais;
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, tomada de decisão em ambientes complexos e habilidade para resolução de conflitos; experiência em negociações com fornecedores e sindicatos;

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Hi there! Thanks for your curiosity

We’re driven by ambition and guided by a bold vision for the years ahead. As we scale our profitable ecosystem of tools and services, we’re seeking a standout HRBP to help us go to a next level.

Who we are

Zubale is a technology company that enables retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of retailers from supermarkets, specialty stores, pharmacies, department stores and fashion brands across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru and Colombia. How? We have three key products:

1) Flexifleet: Freelancer Marketplace to perform picking, packing, and delivery tasks for retailers and aggregators.

2) Fulfillment Optimizer: Modular Software to increase productivity in eCommerce picking, packing and delivery.

3) Consumer Connect: AI WhatsApp Conversational Commerce to boost sales and elevate customer experience.

We are passionate about helping brands, aggregators, and retailers optimize their eCommerce operations, lower costs, and boost profitability. Backed by over $70M USD in venture capital, we’ve delivered consistent growth over the past six years and completed more than 100 million orders through our platform. Today, we serve 100+ customers and engage thousands of freelancers across our network. And this is just the beginning. We're building a profitable, scalable ecosystem — and our vision is to become the #1 partner for retailers to grow their eCommerce business.

Who You Are

You are a non-stoppable, people-oriented, dynamic, collaborative individual contributor who provides innovative custom approaches to employee engagement, culture, human resources, and talent management across the organization. Reporting to the Director of People, you will drive vision execution and position the company for rapid scale.

What You Will Do

  • Manage payroll process.
  • Design, implement and operate our hiring process that is consistent in all markets.
  • Deliver a best-in-class on-boarding experience.
  • Implement surveys, analyse the data and develop action plans to close gaps.
  • Rewards and Incentives: leveraging current compensation and incentives plan, as well as benchmarking vs other companies and industries to ensure our schemes are fit for the future.
  • Prepare reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends.
  • Protect organization’s value by keeping information confidential.
  • Comply with local legal requirements by studying existing and new legislation; anticipating legislation; enforcing adherence to requirements; advising management on needed actions.
  • Participate in developing department goals, objectives and systems.
  • Handle employee relations counseling, outplacement counseling and exit interviewing.
  • Own the plan and logistics of internal events.
  • Implement performance review programs.
  • Design and implement training programs.
  • Design and implement career growth plans.

The Skills And Experience You Will Bring

  • You’re passionate about People and creating a thriving culture and positive working environment for all employees.
  • Previous People / HR Management experience, ideally but not a must within the FMCG or Retail sector.
  • Startup experience is desired - ability to work within a complex and evolving business environment.
  • Highly Organized: Strong project management skills; must be able to effectively manage and balance high-priority requests with long-term projects (and create the tracking tools and cross-team ways of working to enable this).
  • Detail-Oriented: Ability to go deep into problems and create comprehensive plans and strategy, based on specific market details.
  • Impact and influence: you will be working with senior stakeholders and Co-founders across our business, so will need to manage upwards.
  • Agile: We are looking for an individual that would thrive in our fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent Interpersonal and Communication Skills.
  • 5+ years of experience in an HR function and/or a generalist role.
  • English proficiency is mandatory, Spanish is good to have.

description:

Buscamos nosso(a) primeiro(a) profissional de People & Talent (Generalista Pleno) para ligar o motor de contratações e organizar o básico de People Ops com processos simples e dados na veia.

Aplique aqui no LinkedIn e envie CV + 3 bullets com resultados mensuráveis (ex.: “preenchi 12 vagas em 60 dias”; “offer-accept 82%”; “70% dos novos bateram meta em 90 dias”).

title: Financial Project Analyst
description:
What is the scope of this role?

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. Responsibilities include preparing and analyzing financial reports, collaborating with Project Managers on resourcing and discrepancies, and supporting project closeouts. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Finance Project Analyst will act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs (LOE – level of effort, T&E, 3rd party Budget consumption, milestones acceptance, invoicing and cash receipts status)
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • As a Project Financial Analyst, you will record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes

What skills and experience will you need for this role?

  • 6 - 8 years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail

title: LATAM Training Supervisor
description:
Join Our Team as a LATAM Training Supervisor!

Are you a proactive individual with a talent for building relationships and achieving results? We are seeking a dynamic Training Supervisor to lead the development and implementation of high-quality training programs for our customers, distributors, and partners. You will work closely with our Service Manager to transform training needs into successes, executing innovative training strategies and ensuring exceptional training experiences.

The Big Picture (Purpose):

The Training Supervisor will be instrumental in developing and executing high-quality training programs tailored for our customers, distributors, and partners. This role is dedicated to enhancing the knowledge and skills of stakeholders, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary expertise to use, promote, and support Alliance Laundry products effectively. The Training Supervisor will collaborate with various departments to identify key training needs, create engaging educational content, and deliver impactful training sessions using a variety of mediums. By fostering strong relationships and providing exceptional training experiences, the Training Supervisor will help strengthen brand loyalty, improve partner performance, and drive the overall success of Alliance Laundry in the marketplace.

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities):

  • Identify training needs by analyzing performance evaluations and gathering feedback from customers.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive technical training programs that align with the company's strategic objectives.
  • Coordinate logistics for training sessions, including scheduling, venue arrangements, and procurement of necessary materials.
  • Manage the training budget effectively to optimize resource allocation and utilization.
  • Deliver training sessions through various formats, including in-person workshops, webinars, and lectures.
  • Select and oversee external instructors or facilitators as needed to ensure high-quality training delivery.
  • Develop and utilize evaluation tools, such as quizzes and surveys, to assess the effectiveness of training programs.
  • Gather and analyze participant feedback to continuously refine and improve training content and delivery.
  • Maintain detailed records of training activities, including participant engagement and outcomes.
  • Prepare regular reports on training progress and its impact on partner and stakeholder performance.
  • Collaborate with different departments to ensure alignment of training initiatives with organizational goals.
  • Participate in strategic meetings to discuss the development and deployment of technicians throughout Brazil and the Latin American region.
  • Actively recruit new technicians to address coverage gaps in underserved areas.
  • Manage resources and maintain relationships with ABRALAV to support training initiatives.
  • Work closely with the North American Training Group to ensure alignment and leverage shared resources and strategies.
  • Collaborate with the LATAM marketing team to provide technical validation, ensuring the accuracy of marketing materials.

What you need to bring to the table (Experience):

Education & Experience:

  • Knowledge of Chemistry, mechanics, electrical, electronics and pneumatics.
  • Experience with deepwater oil extraction equipment, corrosion protection systems, programming and configuration of professional laundry equipment software, general maintenance and application of training for professional laundry maintenance technicians.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Skills and Abilities:

  • Service-oriented: understands customer issues and is willing to help.
  • Strong ability to work independently and manage workload effectively.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in Spanish and English.
  • Practical knowledge of mechanics, electronics, and electrical systems.
  • Ability to work with others, assertive and diplomatic.
  • Must be able to travel up to 70% of the time.

Standard and Physical Requirements:

  • Position may involve standing for long periods, manual dexterity, stooping, bending.
  • Position requires the ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs. rarely. For greater weight items assistive devices will be provided.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting; close vision, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must have a clean Motor Vehicle Record.

Alliance Team Members Demonstrate DRIVE:

  • Dedicated: Follows through on commitments. Strong say/do.
  • Respectful: Acts with integrity and values diverse perspective.
  • Innovative: Always looking for a better way; leads change.
  • Versatile: Adapts quickly to changing circumstances. Demonstrates agility.
  • Engaged: Acts like an owner. Wants to create and grow a business which is tightly aligned with market needs.

title: Senior Advisor, Country Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.

The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.g., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program; adapt strategy proactively

2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities; b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure; c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators; and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.

3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.

4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.

5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.

6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized; access to waste management; jobs created; safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.

7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).

Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

title: Medical Science Liaison Pleno - Temporário 7 meses
description:
Somos uma companhia farmacêutica dedicada a paciente, médicos e toda a comunidade brasileira. Presente em 18 países, contamos com uma equipe comprometida e motivada para desenvolver, elaborar e comercializar produtos inovadores de alta qualidade a fim de melhorar a qualidade de vida de todos.

Valorizamos e consideramos todas as pessoas candidatas qualificadas para nossas oportunidades, independentemente da etnia, raça, idade, religião ou crença, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, acessibilidade social, estado civil entre outras protegidas por lei. A diversidade é essencial para evoluirmos juntos e continuarmos construindo nossa história de inovação e alta performance.

RESUMO DA DESCRIÇÃO DE CARGO

Responsável por implementar o plano médico tático, alinhado ao plano estratégico dos produtos da empresa, oferecendo suporte médico-científico. Atua como representante da equipe médica, interagindo diretamente com profissionais de saúde (médicos, gestores e outros) para discutir aspectos técnicos conforme o nível de conhecimento de cada um. O profissional realiza o mapeamento e validação de profissionais para compor o painel de interações, planejando atividades de engajamento que ampliem o entendimento sobre os produtos sob sua responsabilidade.

Além disso, identifica lacunas científicas e oportunidades para fortalecer o engajamento de líderes de opinião e equipes multiprofissionais, contribuindo para a estratégia médica e de negócios da empresa. Também realiza treinamentos técnicos sobre administração de produtos, monitoramento de pacientes e manejo de eventos adversos, tanto para equipes internas quanto externas, e colabora em projetos de pesquisa clínica.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Implementar as estratégias de educação médica e disseminação de informações científicas relacionadas aos produtos, garantindo a aderência ao plano estratégico da marca. Conduzir visitas e interações com profissionais de saúde, ajustando o conteúdo científico conforme o nível de conhecimento de cada interlocutor.
  • Atuar como ponto de suporte técnico-científico para equipes de Acesso e Força de Vendas.
  • Monitorar e reportar os eventos adversos, além de garantir a comunicação eficiente de quaisquer desvios relacionados ao uso de produtos.
  • Monitorar e reportar adequadamente os eventos adversos, além de garantir a comunicação eficiente de quaisquer desvios relacionados ao uso de produtos, seguindo as políticas internas e regulamentações vigentes.
  • Representar e posicionar a empresa em congressos e eventos científicos.
  • Participar do planejamento e coordenação de estudos clínicos, desde sua concepção até a publicação de resultados, garantindo conformidade ética e regulatória. Colaborar com os investigadores e coordenar as interações com a equipe interna para garantir o continuidade do projeto.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos sobre o uso seguro e eficaz dos produtos, cobrindo temas como administração, monitoramento e manejo de eventos adversos.
  • Traduzir informações complexas em insights práticos e úteis para a tomada de decisão clínica e estratégica.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica sobre os produtos e sua bula.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos científicos de longo prazo com líderes de opinião.
  • Identificar e analisar lacunas no conhecimento científico relacionado às áreas terapêuticas de atuação e propor atividades educacionais ou científicas para suprir essas deficiências. Contribuir para a formulação de estratégias que aumentem a eficácia do engajamento com profissionais de saúde.
  • Avaliar o potencial de médicos para colaborações científicas, como publicações de artigos e participação em estudos clínicos, alinhadas às estratégias da empresa.
  • Liderar iniciativas educacionais e disseminação de dados científicos.
  • Acompanhar o relato de eventos adversos durante interações de campo e garantir a condução técnica adequada para mitigar riscos e promover a segurança do paciente.
  • Planejar e executar atividades de campo de maneira estratégica, priorizando interações que gerem maior impacto. Atingir metas de desempenho, tanto qualitativas quanto quantitativas, alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios.

CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS

  • +3 anos em área de saúde ou indústria farmacêutica.

title: Especialista em Automação e Software
description:
Sobre a Gruen

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

Atribuições

  • Realizar projetos elétricos em plantas de energias renováveis (biogás).
  • Definir especificações técnicas do projeto.
  • Executar e supervisionar instalações internas e no cliente.
  • Definir sistemas de controle: arquitetura de rede, diagrama de interligação, lista de entradas e saídas, lista de materiais necessários para os projetos, memória de cálculo de dimensionamento de cargas e condutores.
  • Ser responsável pelo projeto elétrico completo de uma planta de biogás.
  • Auxiliar os técnicos elétricos com a montagem e/ou instalação em campo.
  • Criar e/ou adaptar software de projetos anteriores PLC e IHM (Siemens e Rockwell).
  • Realizar teste de equipamentos internamente e em fornecedores.
  • Identificar e realizar melhorias dos equipamentos.
  • Executar os startup e comissionamento dos equipamentos em conjunto com técnicos mecânicos, elétricos e outras pessoas envolvidas.
  • Ajustar e parametrizar diferentes equipamentos elétricos e eletrônicos.
  • Controlar interfaces e funcionamento de todos os módulos.
  • Realizar Interligações e controle de funcionamento em diferentes sistemas de comunicações, como: Profinet, Profibus, PA, As-Interface e outros.
  • Auxiliar o Gerente de Projeto na aprovação dos equipamentos nos fornecedores, bem como no sistema completo de purificação de biogás na planta do cliente.

Qualificações

  • Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Possuir CREA ativo;
  • Conhecimento em Autocad, Eplan, programação Siemens e Rockwell.
  • Habilitação categoria B.
  • Perfil organizado, proativo, dinâmico, boa comunicação oral/escrita e com boa habilidade na resolução de conflitos.

Será visto como um diferencial:

title: Freelance Data Analyst, Social + Paid Media
description:
Position Summary

The social + media data analyst role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and analyzing data sets (from organic social/media/website/campaign) to provide actionable insights and aid with data-driven strategies. The role will be responsible for the development of forward-thinking insights derived from social media data (tools like Sprout, Brandwatch, and native platform), digital/paid media data, publisher reporting, and social listening tools to help guide strategy and creative, as well as contributing to the development of the holistic measurement approach for assigned clients and projects.

This is a remote, international contract role with the ability to work for up to 6 months.

Pay range is R$7.000 - $9.000/month.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Identify and ensure alignment on key performance indicators for organic social and paid media campaigns
  • Develop and execute monitoring and measurement plans based on objectives and agreed-upon KPIs
  • Gather data from third-party tools as well as owned channels and native platforms to generate ongoing performance reports and dashboards
  • Analyze data sets (social media–organic/paid, paid media, etc.) to pull actionable insights and help evolve the overall social and media strategies
  • Structure and analyze informative reports and dashboards to aid organic social teams and digital/paid media teams in campaign optimizations
  • Work with publishing partners to structure reporting cadences and delivery dates
  • Collaborate across departments to communicate insights and findings
  • Present key findings and insights to clients throughout reporting cycles

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 1-3 years of professional work experience within an agency or brand setting
  • Must have a background in analyzing data (social media, media, website) and generating reports, as well as using social listening and monitoring tools to derive insights
  • Ability to translate your research & observations into clear, insightful and visually stimulating presentations that tell a compelling story
  • Ability to clearly and convincingly present findings and insights in a way that demonstrates the value of the data and analysis to clients
  • Experience using social listening tools and content publishing tools (i.e. Brandwatch, Meltwater, Sprinklr, Emplifi, etc.)
  • Experience with reporting dashboard tools like Tableau, Domo, and Power Bi
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (preferably in English) with ability to present ideas and information clearly; keen eye for detail also required
  • Experience and comfort level presenting to clients and key agency stakeholders
  • Ability to communicate with English speaking teams is required

Nice to Have

  • Experience using platforms such as Meta Business Suite
  • Experience with Google Analytics and/or Adobe Analytics
  • Experience brand health partners like Kantar Millward-Brown and Nielsen

Other Duties & Responsibilities

  • Partner with Brand/Comms Strategists and Account Managers to communicate the value of social media monitoring and analytics to clients.
  • Lead efforts in developing holistic measurement action plans across all channels for client campaigns
  • Lead investigative efforts for client measurement inquiries (digital and offline)
  • Partner with media team to aid with campaign trafficking, troubleshooting, optimizations, and reporting

Additional Information:

Pereira O'Dell is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participant in the US Federal E-Verify program. At this time, we are not accepting resumes or candidates from third-party vendors.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia. This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Risk & Audit Expert Talent
description:
Risk & Audit Expert Talent at Randstad Global

Sao Paolo - Brazil, hybrid, fulltime

people at the heart of everything we do

Working at Randstad is unlike working at any organization. Because at Randstad we put people at the heart of everything we do. This goes for our clients, our talent, our employees and society. We combine our passion for people with the power of today’s technologies. This helps us support people and organizations in realizing their true potential. We call this partner for talent..

Learn more about our mission, history and values on our website:

BR&AF

The business risk and audit function (BR&AF) provides assurance and recommendations to the Executive Board and the Audit Committee on Randstad Group’s (risk) management, control and governance practices. Therefore the department facilitates in setting governance standards. It provides advice on internal control improvements, it conducts audits, special investigations and assignments worldwide on request of the Executive Board and Audit Committee. BR&AF’s responsibility includes the quarterly reporting based on: the risk and internal control self assessments, audit results, discussions on internal control weaknesses and analysis of the key risks reported throughout the company's management structure. This also substantiates the Group’s in-control statements.

The global function consists of team members operating through hubs spread over 4 continents. The team is organized in a matrix consisting of control & audit focus teams on business and functional areas (e.g. digital, talent, client, back office & shared service centers and fraud & forensics) and partners that are the linking pin to operating units (business risk & audit partners) with a global view. A support group is set up for professional practice, learning & development, quality improvement & methods, analytics and PMO.

Representatives of the different groups (Focus teams, BR&A Partners and support group) form the BR&AF core management team that reports to the Managing Director BR&AF.

how you will contribute

You are part of the Business Risk & Audit Function (BR&AF) that covers all business operations related to Clients, Talents and our (shared) Back-, Mid- and Front offices, as well as our Accounting & Reporting and other specialist functions like HR.

With your risk & audit experience and expertise you enhance Randstad's in-control situation together with other team members. This by preparing and performing: risk assessments; internal control assessments; audits; and reviews, and compile reports on these activities that make an impact on management.

  • you provide management combined assurance, utilizing insights from enterprise risk management, internal control as well as internal audits that you lead and/or execute. Therewith you create momentum within the company to strengthen the risk-control position for our operational, shared services and accounting processes.
  • you maintain contact with local and international management, global and local process owners and collaborate closely with other involved stakeholders like other impacted functions within the group.
  • you coordinate, execute and report on the outcomes of risk management, internal control and internal audit in close collaboration with other involved and impacted functions within the group, such as: our Client delivery and Talent operations specialists; and HR, Tax, Accounting & Reporting and Planning & Control specialists.
  • you take ownership for the planning, execution and reporting of the risk, internal control and internal audit activities to make impact. You know your impact is there when management follows-up on your reports by implementing operational and control improvements.
  • you are willing to travel. As the standard office locations for the BR&AF team are organized in hubs, like in the country mentioned, travelling is estimated to be about 20% to 30% of the job.

what you will be doing

As an independent and objective risk & audit expert, you are going to:

  • participate and take the lead in risk assessments and audit planning and scoping, including researching relevant business objectives, policies, regulations.
  • prepare and execute audits by evaluating and analyzing the design and operating effectiveness of controls in mitigating identified risks.
  • execute audits and reviews for operational processes and controls, in areas such as: client delivery and Talent intake, as well as shared services operations and specialist functions like HR management, marketing & communication, finance, accounting & reporting, planning & control, non-financial reporting.
  • participate and lead audit interviews, be accountable to prepare audit workpapers and reporting, as well as assist in drafting audit findings and recommendations for management, based on identified control weaknesses or process improvements.
  • support and monitor the follow-up implementation of corrective actions by management.
  • act as a recourse for colleagues with less expertise.

who will you work with

  • Business operations managers both working with our Clients and Talents, as well as shared services center managers and functional specialists in all territories where Randstad is active
  • Business operations and shared services process owners and control owners in all territories where Randstad is active
  • Tax and Legal counterparts (including legal compliance leads) both at corporate level as well as in our operating companies
  • MD BR&AF, other BR&AF leaders, team members and business partners
  • External co-source partners

what you will bring

Your risk & audit skills are well developed, as a critical challenger to process owners and business managers you strike the right tone. You have a keen interest and business acumen for Client delivery and Talent related operational processes as well as shared services organizations, how they serve internal customers and optimize their operations. You have a broad interest in specialist functions that support the overall governance of Randstad's international presence.

As an Internal Audit Expert you:

  • have minimum 8 years of relevant experience
  • have minimum master degree in business or economics and related accreditation (e.g. CPA/CA/CIA/ACCA)
  • have level BEC B1/B2 or higher Business English, preferably combined with proficiency in one of the following languages: Dutch, Spanish, French, Italian and /or German
  • have a strong independent mindset
  • are experienced in international stakeholder management & change
  • are an innovative thinker that challenges the status quo
  • have experience with excel in risk & audit methodologies & tools and internal control theories
  • have an agile and flexible working style and passion for on the job learning & development
  • have a proven track record in control design & implementation, risk based auditing and reporting.
  • are experienced in performing integrated audits working with changing teams
  • are specialized depth and breadth of expertise in business process risk analysis
  • have experience with data driven analysis

your competencies

Within Randstad we defined the following Leadership competencies:

  • delighting people: connect people (client, talent, employee, society), building strong client relationships and delivering client-centric solutions.
  • performing today: resourcefulness securing and developing resources effectively and efficiently.
  • leading change: manages ambiguity operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  • securing the future: drives vision and purpose painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others into action.
  • creating clarity - showing line of sight: making sense of complex, high quantity and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems and provides direction, is delegating and removing obstacles to get work done
  • courage to challenge: shows courage and confidence to speak up skillfully, challenging others even when they are confronted with resistance or unfamiliar circumstances
  • collaborates, reaches out, you excel in organizational sensitivity: maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process and people-related organizational dynamics recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization

what’s in it for you

We put people at the heart of everything we do. Our employment conditions reflect this and are in accordance with the applicable (local) Randstad employment policies and related personnel guide.

We want our teams and talent to reflect the rich diversity of the societies we serve. We thrive for an environment of belonging, safety and confidence. So everyone can bring their whole selves to work and flourish. Learn more about equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging at randstad here.

If you recognize yourself in the profile above, we invite you to apply for this role. For more information you can reach out to our recruitment business partner:

The recruitment procedure consists of a screening and at least two interviews. Later in the process, an (online) assessment and a job offer conversation take place.

To apply, please submit your resume (CV) and a cover letter.

title: Data Analytics Consultant
description:
About Making Science

Making Science is an international digital acceleration company with over 1,200 experts across 15 markets, including Spain, Portugal, Mexico, Colombia, France, Italy, the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Germany, Georgia, and the USA. As a proud consulting partner of Local Planet — the world’s premier network of independent media agencies — we deliver a suite of digital, technology, and performance marketing services to a global clientele. Our expertise spans digital marketing and MarTech, software and cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and SaaS, all underscored by a relentless pursuit of innovation.

Making Science was ranked 15th in the FT1000: Europe's Fastest-Growing Companies 2023. Committed to making a positive impact, Making Science actively engages in various ESG initiatives. We’ve joined forces with the Climate Pledge, the United Nations Global Compact, and Pledge1%, dedicating resources and efforts to support non-profit organizations. Through these endeavors, we are committed to driving meaningful change for a brighter, more sustainable future.

As part of its commitment to innovation, Making Science offers its clients end-to-end capabilities required for consulting, development, integration, and maintenance of advanced IT solutions. Our global network of delivery hubs not only fosters job growth but also serves as an incubator for cultivating top-tier tech talent, fueling projects that accelerate transformation and modernisation.

Our team is composed of digital native professionals, who have a wide knowledge in the different stages and disciplines of the digital transformation: Digital Strategy, Infrastructures, Software Development, Creativity and UX/UI Design, Digital Marketing, and Big Data.

Some details about your department

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Data Analytics Consultant with a strong focus on Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to join our team in Brazil. In this role, you will be responsible for managing local data analytics projects, helping our clients to leverage their data to drive business decisions. You will be the go-to person for GA4 implementation, analysis, and reporting, working closely with our clients to understand their needs and deliver actionable insights.

What we’d like you to do

Implement, configure, and manage Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM) for our clients.

Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide insights to stakeholders.

Analyze website and marketing campaign data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Manage local data analytics projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope.

Collaborate with internal teams and clients to understand their business objectives and provide data-driven recommendations.

Provide training and support to clients on how to use and interpret GA4 data.

Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in digital analytics and GA4.

What we’d like you to bring

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.

Proven experience working with Google Analytics (GA4 is a must).

Experience with Google Tag Manager.

Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Fluent in both Portuguese and English.

Perks of joining us

We give you complete stability with an indefinite job contract.

We offer a fixed salary according to your worth and experience, plus a performance based bonus.

Do you know someone that fits in Making Science? Refer him or her, and you can get a bonus if they’re hired!

Feedback is part of our day to day lives. We recognize a job well done through a continuous feedback model.

The opportunity to meet our international team with our Ambassadors Program.

We care about a healthy work-life balance. You can count on having flexible working hours and one day a week where you can work from home.

You will never stop learning with us: subsidized training, free language classes, learning capsules, an e-learning platform, and many more.

Work comfortably and follow your own style, because we don’t have a dress code.

We know how to have a good time!

Never go hungry with our free daily fruit and our vending machine card!

Take a break on our terrace, play foosball, darts, or PlayStation

Be a part of a young, adventurous, and professional team, with people you’ll grow fond of!

Coordinate local service provider resources to ensure rapid problem resolution and efficient use of personnel, equipment, and time to meet project needs effectively.

Provide standard operating procedures and documentation support, regularly reporting progress on localized solutions to headquarters.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT-related fields, or Engineering.

At least 3 years of experience in IT network and data center system integration maintenance.

Familiarity with enterprise-level network architecture and equipment management. Knowledge of routing protocols such as Static Routing, OSPF, and BGP; VPN technologies including GRE, SSL VPN, and IPSec VPN; and wireless authentication protocols like EAP, PEAP, and TLS.

Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.g. Zabbix, Grafana) and experience in operations automation tools.

Experience in managing CCTV, access control systems, facial recognition devices, and UPS systems is preferred.

Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, access control systems, racks and cables, with knowledge of their strengths and weaknesses.

Proven experience in developing and implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements.

Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams.

Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Arabic and English, for effective communication is preferred.

Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.g. CCIE) or project management certifications (e.g. PMP) is an advantage.

title: Assistente de Visual Merchandising - Shopping Ibirapuera
description:
Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

Apaixonado por moda e esportes? Então esta é sua chance! Aqui, você vai deixar nossas lojas sempre estilosas e irresistíveis, garantindo que cada vitrine e ambiente mostre as últimas tendências.

Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

  • Manter a loja sempre atrativa, com ambientes e vitrines que reforcem a nossa paixão pelo esporte, por meio das tendências de moda.
  • Garantir a identidade da nossa marca na loja.
  • Oferecer suporte e apoio aos nossos clientes e ao time.

Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Conhecimento em moda, relacionado a tendências, identidade visual e estratégias de marketing
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade no aprendizado

Sobre a Centauro

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado, afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Analista de Redes JR
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com o objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.

Atualmente, contamos com mais de 11 mil colaboradores e estamos presentes em mais de 225 escritórios ao redor do mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Redes JR para integrar nosso time de NOC. Essa posição terá papel estratégico no monitoramento de ambientes e no suporte técnico remoto a clientes que utilizam tecnologias como SDWAN, Redes e Segurança, garantindo performance, disponibilidade e qualidade dos serviços.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Monitorar ambientes físicos e lógicos, analisando indicadores nas ferramentas de monitoramento;
  • Registrar falhas e acompanhar incidentes até a resolução;
  • Executar rotinas diárias de monitoramento, checklists e controle de incidentes;
  • Atualizar chamados em ferramenta ITSM;
  • Consultar e abrir chamados junto às operadoras, acompanhando seu andamento.

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência em atendimento remoto a clientes;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de ITSM (abertura e acompanhamento de chamados);
  • Conhecimentos básicos em Troubleshooting;
  • Redes: DHCP, DNS, WAN, LAN, DDNS, PPPoE;
  • Conhecimento técnico em Windows 7, 8 e 10;
  • Redes TCP/IP, switches, roteadores e firewall;
  • Experiência com abertura e escalation de chamados em operadoras;

Diferenciais:

  • Certificação ITIL V4;
  • Certificação CCNA;
  • Experiência em SDWAN (Cisco, Fortinet, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana, PRTG, Solarwinds);
  • Experiência com fabricantes como Sophos, Zyxel, Huawei, HP, D-Link, Alcatel.

Informações adicionais:

  • Escala: 12x36
  • Horário: 19h às 07h
  • Local: São Paulo/SP – Presencial

title: Analista de Projetos Sustentáveis
description:
Venha fazer parte do maior ecossistema brasileiro dedicado à transição para uma economia regenerativa e de baixo carbono.

Na AYA, sustentabilidade, inovação, impacto social e propósito se encontram todos os dias para transformar o Brasil em referência global em soluções para o futuro do planeta.

Aqui, natureza, tecnologia, ciência, criatividade e colaboração caminham juntas em um ambiente vivo, pulsante e comprometido com o bem comum.

Missão do Cargo:

Atuar como apoio estratégico e operacional no engajamento de membros, clientes e parceiros da AYA, conectando temas de sustentabilidade, descarbonização e mudanças climáticas às plataformas de ação climática e aos conteúdos desenvolvidos pela organização.   • Dar suporte na coordenação de projetos e plataformas de ação climática da AYA.

  • Interagir com áreas internas (marketing, projetos, operações) e com parceiros estratégicos, clientes e membros da AYA.
  • Auxiliar na organização da agenda de conteúdos e entregas.
  • Medir e reportar engajamento de conteúdos (alcance, qualidade, feedback de áreas e clientes).
  • Acompanhar tendências e novos temas relevantes para os projetos de clima e sustentabilidade da AYA.

  • Desenvolvimento das Plataformas de Ação Climática e geração de negócio dentro das plataformas.

  • Capacidade de síntese.

  • Plano odontológico OdontoPrev

title: Assistente de tesouraria
description:
Sobre a Bip

Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...

I. Ser a empresa que sempre sonhamos e que sonhamos para sempre

Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

II. Presente em ecossistema inovador

Significa ter e desenvolver constantemente, internamente ou através de parceiros, soluções inovadoras que promovam impactos em nossos clientes e que sejam o pilar de nossa perenidade. Pois só um repensar constante nos manterá atuantes no mercado.

III. Socialmente Engajada

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

Profissional se adapte rapidamente e contribua com fluidez ao time

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência
  • Boa comunicação
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Resiliência e adaptabilidade
  • Comprometimento com prazos e qualidade

SOMOS DIFERENTES DE TUDO O QUE VOCÊ JÁ VIU!

Faça parte da BIP: Um ecossistema inovador, humano, ousado e revolucionário.

Somos uma consultoria internacional de transformação de negócios, fundada na Itália em 2003, há 20 anos impactando milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho.

Com nosso espírito jovem, vivemos em um ecossistema em evolução que entrega transformação significativa por meio de uma abordagem personalizada.

Por aqui, não falta oportunidade para você crescer.

ESTAMOS PRESENTE EM DIVERSOS LOCAIS DO MUNDO!

+40 países de atuação + 5000 Bipers pelo mundo +700 projetos no mercado

Tudo o que temos e construímos para um futuro que se aproxima, é guiado pelo nosso

PROPÓSITO:

Pursuing Changes, Nurturing Progress

title: Programa de Estágio - 2026

Quem é a LiuGong Latin America?

A LiuGong Latin America (LGLA) foi fundada no Brasil em 2008 e é uma subsidiária integral do Grupo LiuGong. Desde 2015 fabricando equipamentos no país, a LiuGong vem crescendo nos mercados brasileiro e latino-americano. O negócio abrange a venda e manutenção de equipamentos e acessórios para máquinas de construção, soluções de financiamento, treinamento de clientes, consultoria técnica e outros escopos, os principais produtos incluem carregadeiras de rodas, escavadeiras, motoniveladoras, rolos compactadores, retroescavadeiras, escavadeiras, caminhões rígidos, plataformas aéreas de trabalho, etc. Além disso, a LiuGong continua desenvolvendo a estrutura de sua montadora e centro de treinamento localizado na cidade de Mogi Guaçu e escritórios comerciais nas cidades de Campinas e Belo Horizonte, fortalecendo o corpo de profissionais e qualificando o portfólio de produtos.

  • Disponibilidade para estagiar presencialmente em Campinas-SP, Mogi Guaçu-SP ou Belo Horizonte- MG.

title: ASSISTENTE TÉCNICO E GERENCIAL
description:
Vaga: Assistente Técnico(a) de Campo

Local de Atuação: Diversas regiões do Rio Grande do Sul Regime: Tempo Integral, presencial

Sobre a VON HAUSEN CONSULTORIA

A VON HAUSEN CONSULTORIA é uma empresa líder em assistência técnica rural, especializada no desenvolvimento e capacitação de todo o setor Agro. Nossa equipe é composta por Agrônomos(as), Médicos(as) Veterinários(as), Biólogos, Zootecnistas, Engenheiros(as) de Alimentos, Engenheiros(as) Agrícolas e Técnicos(as) em Eletromecânica, todos(as) com ampla experiência para oferecer suporte técnico e estratégico a produtores, estudantes, administradores e demais profissionais do agronegócio.

O Desafio do Cargo

Buscamos um(a) Assistente Técnico(a) de Campo para integrar nossa equipe. Este(a) profissional será responsável por prestar assistência técnica e suporte direto aos produtores rurais, atuando como um elo crucial entre o conhecimento técnico especializado da VON HAUSEN CONSULTORIA e as necessidades práticas do campo. O objetivo é resolver desafios, otimizar processos e impulsionar a produtividade agropecuária nas regiões atendidas.

Principais Responsabilidades Diárias

  • Prestar assistência e suporte técnico contínuo diretamente no campo.
  • Realizar atendimento qualificado e proativo ao produtor rural, compreendendo suas demandas e oferecendo soluções.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos específicos das atividades agropecuárias.
  • Coletar, analisar e interpretar dados técnicos para subsidiar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de soluções eficazes.
  • Manter uma comunicação clara e eficiente, tanto com a equipe interna quanto com os produtores atendidos, garantindo o fluxo de informações e o acompanhamento das ações.

REQUISITOS INDISPENSÁVEIS PARA A CANDIDATURA

Para esta posição, é fundamental que o(a) candidato(a) atenda aos seguintes critérios mandatórios:

Experiência Comprovada em Assistência Técnica e Suporte de Campo:

  • Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência direta e comprovada na prestação de assistência técnica e suporte em campo.

Experiência em, pelo menos, uma das seguintes áreas do agronegócio:

  • Fruticultura
  • Olericultura
  • Grãos
  • Bovinocultura de Corte
  • Bovinocultura de Leite
  • Ovinocultura
  • Apicultura
  • Agroindústria

Registro Ativo em Conselho de Classe:

  • Possuir registro ativo e regularizado no conselho profissional pertinente à sua formação (Exemplos: CREA, CRMV, CRBIO, etc.).

Habilitação e Acesso a Veículo para Campo:

  • Possuir CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação) válida, Categoria B ou superior.
  • Ter capacidade e acesso a um veículo para deslocamento em campo (seja veículo próprio, alugado ou emprestado). A empresa não exige a posse de um veículo, mas a disponibilidade e o uso para as atividades do cargo são requisitos essenciais.

Habilidades Analíticas Desenvolvidas:

  • Aptidão comprovada para coletar, analisar e interpretar dados técnicos complexos, transformando informações em soluções práticas e eficazes para os desafios do campo.

Excelência em Comunicação e Atendimento:

  • Demonstrar habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita claras, objetivas e eficientes.
  • Experiência prévia e comprovada em atendimento direto e de qualidade ao produtor rural.

DIFERENCIAIS (O que Valorizamos)

Serão considerados um diferencial para a candidatura, adicionando valor ao seu perfil:

  • Formação técnica em áreas correlatas ao agronegócio.
  • Experiência anterior em funções similares à de Assistente Técnico de Campo.

title: Content Rater
description:
Job Title: Content Rater

Location: Av. Maria Coelho Aguiar, 215 - Jardim São Luís, São Paulo - SP,

100% Onsite.

Work from office 9am-4pm BRT.

Salary: BRL 2100/month

Languages required: Portuguese and English

About the Role

Our project currently seeks a Content Rater. The main goal of this position is to identify and rate various types of content (mostly text, but it can also include audio, video and photos) as per the defined policies and guidelines. The responsibilities include reviewing and rating user/AI-generated content. Ratings should be made within the provided task guidelines and supported by written explanations to enhance rating quality.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Evaluate and rate various content types, including mostly text, but also audio, video and photos.
  • Assess AI generated responses for accuracy, factuality, relevance, helpfulness, language usage, and alignment with user intent.
  • Conduct research & fact-checking by comparing AI-generated response with other generally available sources (ex: Web search, social media, 3rd party materials) and identify key differences and trends.
  • Conduct side-by-side comparisons and identify key differences between responses.
  • Rate and stack rank responses& provide clear reasoning while ensuring adherence to guidelines
  • Ensure consistency in rating decisions
  • Supporting internal training
  • Conducting QA/Peer reviews
  • Attend customer calls/calibration sessions/calls
  • Supporting other projects outside of your core project, as and when required,
  • Re-writing prompts or responses

Skills Requirements & Qualifications

  • English B1/B2
  • Native in Portuguese language to perform the content rating
  • University Degree (preferred)
  • 1 year of relevant experience (inclusive of journalism, literature, writing or other comparable experience)
  • Basic level computer handling skills (along with a typing speed of 25-30 words per minute)
  • Comfortable with G suite, especially Google Sheets
  • Excellent in verbal & writing skills with the ability to present reasoning in a clear, concise, and logical manner
  • Understanding of various AI models and their capabilities.
  • Knowledge of established guidelines and best practices for content rating.
  • Experience in evaluating and comparing content from different sources.
  • Detail oriented, rigorous, analytical skills to assess content factuality, relevance, and alignment with user intent.
  • Research skills to evaluate content accuracy and identify trustworthy sources.
  • Critical thinking skills to identify biases, inconsistencies, and limitations in AI-generated responses.
  • Attention to detail to review content for grammar, style, and adherence to ethical/legal standards.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).

In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.

No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.

To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.

Like what you see? Apply now!

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation: You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility: You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360, Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia, TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

  • Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência;
